column1: # Reference Tex extents for the width oracle (fm-tex-metrics-glyphs-ru72).
# Each row is the pinned Reference's Tex(source) get_width()/get_height() in scene units at the
# default font_size 48: 3b1b/manim 6199a00d, align* display math, pdfTeX 3.141592653-2.6-1.40.28 (TeX Live 2025/Debian); dvisvgm 3.6,
# measured 2026-10-20 by scripts/capture_tex_reference_widths.py through a private TeX cache.
# authored rows name their source; corpus rows only the digest sha256(mode NUL text) of a private
# corpus string, with its occurrence count. 22 candidates the Reference could not
# typeset alone, and 4 fragments that typeset no glyph, are omitted. `class` is plain
# when TeX set the string in Computer Modern (cm*, the EC text fonts), traced when only in EC
# text fonts, which this host's dvisvgm traced from bitmaps, and fallback when its DVI loads any
# Re-measure only by rerunning the capture; never edit by hand.
